plain_description.what: Re-judges 600 frontier matches with the two answers in swapped order. It uses repeats of identical prompts to separate how much verdict flipping is due to answer position and how much is plain judge noise. Uses 596 judge calls.
plain_description.why: A new model seemed over-ranked in an earlier arena, and the question was whether presentation order (position bias) caused it.
plain_description.information: Position bias above noise would mean arenas must judge both orders. Result: about half the 12% flip rate is position (about 7 points) and half is noise (about 6 points). The newcomer wins 70% when shown first vs 56% when shown second. Its lead shrinks a lot but it still ranks first. Practical rule: new arena extensions must judge both orders. Ruled history rather than evidence (older question pool).
